messages:
ana: heads up — starting rollout thread for model v3-int4. did a small canary in staging, results below and a gate proposal. looking for quick feedback before we open fraction.

dmitri: can you paste the core numbers? latency / quality / throughput delta?

ana: quick paste from the staging shadow run (aggregate):
- baseline v3-fp16: p95 latency 230ms, throughput 420 req/s, QA exact-match 78.9%, rouge-L 46.2
- v3-int4 (quant4+nf4): p95 latency 150ms, throughput 680 req/s, QA exact-match 77.0%, rouge-L 45.6
- relative: -1.9% EM, -0.6 rouge-L, +48% throughput, p95 -35%

lia: that EM drop is small but non-trivial. how about slice-levels? long-docs / code-gen / instruction-following? any hallucination uptick?

ana: slice breakdown (staging shadow):
- long-docs (>2k tokens): EM -3.4%, rouge-L -1.8
- instruction-following prompts: EM -0.8%
- code-gen: negligible EM change but more token-level formatting diffs
- hallucination proxy (contradiction detector): false-positive rate +0.4pp overall, +1.1pp on long-docs

sam: propose rollout gate config (canary + auto-fallback). minimal and conservative:
```yaml
canary_percent: 5
monitoring_window: 60m
metrics:
  - name: qa_exact_match
    comparator: relative_drop
    threshold: 0.02   # revert if >2% relative drop
    weight: 0.6
  - name: rouge_l
    comparator: absolute_drop
    threshold: 0.8   # revert if >0.8 pts absolute
    weight: 0.2
  - name: p95_latency
    comparator: relative_increase
    threshold: 1.5   # revert if p95 > 1.5x baseline
    weight: 0.2
fallback_policy: immediate_on_any_threshold_breach
```

dmitri: mixing absolute and relative thresholds + weights is fine, but i want a KL/LM-plausibility signal included. small KL shift often correlates with quality drift on some slices.

sam: good call. add model_kl_shift with threshold 0.03 (relative) and weight 0.1, and make composite score require weighted_drop > 0.025 to trigger auto-revert.

lia: also flag sustained spikes. if p95 spikes > 1.3x for 3 consecutive windows (60m) we shouldn't wait for composite; rollback early. observed that int4 has occasional cache-regen stalls under burst.

.eval-bot: smoke-check results for v3-int4 at 5% canary (2026-03-20T14:07Z):
- traffic sampled: 43k requests
- qa_exact_match delta: -1.85% (p<0.01)
- rouge_l delta: -0.58 pts
- p95 latency: 145ms (baseline 230ms)
- kl_shift: 0.028
- alerts: none triggered in 1h window

ana: based on that i suggest this procedural plan:
1) launch 3% canary for 2h with the gate config above (add kl_shift 0.03).
2) shadow full traffic for 24h and run offline eval slices (long-docs, safety, legal).
3) if composite weighted_drop <= 0.02 and no slice has >2.5% EM drop, promote to 10% for 8h.
4) on any threshold breach -> immediate rollback and create a postmortem.

sam: i'll implement the gate JSON and deploy the canary job. i'll also wire the composite metric into console as a short card.

dmitri: please @oncall in the rollout playbook step, and add a manual hold for legal slice regression >1.5% (we don't want to auto-fallback for legal without a human ack).

lia: thanks — i can run focused safety evals and watch hallucination detector while canary is live. ping me if we see long-docs regressions.

ana: perfect. i'll kick off infra changes in 10m. tagging here for visibility: @sam @dmitri @lia. :thumbsup:

sam: acked. will push gate and report back when canary is live. :rocket:
